title: Classical torsion cohomology bound on proper weakly contractible neighborhoods
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $e\geq0$ be an integer bounding the Krull dimensions of all fibres of every base change of $f$ [def-pc-base-change] [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $V\to Y$ be an affine weakly contractible object of the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] [sk-def-pe-weak-contractible], put $Z=X\times_YV$, and let $h:Z\to V$ be the projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use ordinary module sheaves over the constant ring $A$, their total K-injective derived direct images and derived sections [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For every classical $A$-module sheaf $H$ on $Z_{\mathrm{proét}}$, meaning $H\cong\nu_Z^*F$ for an étale $A$-module sheaf $F$ [det-pe-classical-sheaves-modules], one has
$$\mathcal H^qRh_*(H[0])=0,\qquad H^qR\Gamma(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},H[0])=0\qquad(q>2e).$$
The assertion ranges over all classical sheaves on $Z$, including ones that do not descend from $X$. No Noetherianity of $V$, constructibility of $H$, or invertibility of the additive exponent of $A$ is assumed.

proof.text: Base change of the proper morphism $f$ along $V\to Y$ is proper, so $h:Z\to V$ is proper. The assumed bound applies in particular to every fibre of $h$, with the same integer $e$. Properness includes finite type and separatedness. Finite type includes quasi-compactness, and separatedness implies quasi-separatedness; hence $h$ satisfies the qcqs hypothesis of the comparison theorem.

source.place: Tag 01W4, lemma-base-change-proper; Tag 01KK, definition-separated, and Tag 01K7, lemma-closed-immersion-quasi-compact

proof.text: Choose the etale sheaf F and its comparison isomorphism from the stated classicality hypothesis. The positive integer card(A) kills every local section of its underlying abelian sheaf: card(A) times x equals (card(A) times 1_A) times x, which is zero. This also treats the zero ring. Apply the proper torsion direct-image bound to the projection and this torsion abelian sheaf, and transfer back through the higher-direct-image forgetful isomorphism. Faithfulness of coefficient forgetting detects zero.

source.place: Tag 095U, lemma-cohomological-dimension-proper; Tag 03FD, lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree; bounded-below injective computation

proof.text: The proved source bounded-below/unbounded compatibility identifies this etale higher direct image with homology of the total derived direct image of F[0]. The canonical total-derived comparison mate is invertible there because the projection is qcqs and F[0] is bounded below. Exact comparison inverse image commutes with homology. Compose the mate with the single-functor comparison and the classicality isomorphism, giving the asserted total proper direct-image bound for H[0].

proof.text: Choose a faithfully flat ind-etale w-contractible algebra S over Gamma(V,O), and let p:Spec S -> V be the resulting affine surjective weakly etale cover. Composition with V -> Y defines a singleton cover in Y_proet. The induced map of representable sheaves is epi: two maps out of h_V equal after p agree by sheaf separatedness. Weak contractibility of V lifts id_V along this epimorphism, giving a section s of p. The object Spec S -> V is weakly contractible in V_proet by the proved affine w-contractible evaluation theorem. Given a locally surjective map of set sheaves on V_proet and a section over its final object, restrict to Spec S, lift there, then restrict along s. Since s followed by p is the identity, this is a lift of the original section. Thus the final object of V_proet is weakly contractible. Evaluation of module sheaves there preserves epis (forget to sets and use this lifting property) and preserves kernels (computed sectionwise), hence is exact. No slice-topos or variable-ring module bridge is needed.

source.place: Tags 0990, 090M and 0946; splitting a contractible affine cover and exact evaluation

proof.text: Base change of the terminal object of V_proet is terminal in Z_proet. The unique terminal-object isomorphism yields the natural isomorphism h_* followed by Gamma(V,-) with Gamma(Z,-), objectwise by restriction of the sheaf along that isomorphism. The direct image preserves K-injective complexes, as the right adjoint of exact inverse image. Apply the proved total-derived composition theorem. Since Gamma(V,-) is exact by the preceding step, its derived functor is its exact derived-category functor and commutes with homology. Apply it to the first bound, obtaining the global-sections bound.
